headline: Zcash Developers Confirm November Date for NU7 Upgrade
summary: Zcash developers have confirmed a November launch for the NU7 network upgrade, which aims to triple payment speed by cutting block times to 25 seconds.
why: Zcash is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency utilizing zero-knowledge proofs for shielded transactions.

impacts.name: Zcash
impacts.why: Announcements of network upgrades improving transaction speeds often stimulate near-term positive market sentiment.
